rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, but then executed multiple order-changing actions without any user confirmation. They attempted both an exchange and a return on the same tablet item, canceled the charger without confirming the condition (and without confirming at all), and processed a sneaker return without confirmation. The user also asked for the tracking number, but no tracking information was provided in the final response. The closing message does not summarize actions or provide required details. These actions violate the policy requirements to confirm before writes and to provide correct final information, and they did not follow the user’s preference to do one thing at a time.
